args.title: Update Toast and ToastProvider for error toasts accessibility and dismissal
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Update ToastProvider and Toast so that error toasts use aria-live="assertive" (or are in an assertive region) and do not auto-dismiss after five seconds (requiring manual dismissal).

label: bug
file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

ToastProvider uses role="status" and aria-live="polite" for all toasts, and Toast always sets a 5-second setTimeout for auto-dismissal regardless of kind. Updating ToastProvider and Toast so that error toasts use aria-live="assertive" and do not auto-dismiss after five seconds ensures critical errors are properly announced and persist until manual dismissal.
